description: Curated database of AI-specific vulnerabilities, CVEs, and attack patterns from 2023-2026. Includes real-world incidents, affected frameworks, OWASP LLM Top 10 mapping, and remediation steps.

vulnerabilities.name: OpenAI ChatGPT Prompt Injection via System Message Override
vulnerabilities.description: ChatGPT vulnerable to prompt injection attacks where crafted user inputs can override system instructions, leading to data exfiltration and unauthorized actions.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement input sanitization, structural separation of system/user prompts, and output validation.

vulnerabilities.name: Anthropic Claude RAG Poisoning Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: RAG-enabled Claude models can be poisoned through manipulated retrieval contexts, allowing attackers to inject malicious instructions into retrieved documents.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement RAG context sanitization, source verification, and multi-layer input validation.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Bard SQL Injection in Code Generation
vulnerabilities.description: Bard can generate SQL queries containing injection payloads when prompted with malicious inputs, leading to potential database compromise.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add SQL injection detection to generated code, implement parameterized query generation, and validate all database-related outputs.

vulnerabilities.name: Hugging Face Model Hub Backdoor Injection
vulnerabilities.description: Malicious models uploaded to Hugging Face Hub contain backdoors that activate when specific triggers are present in inputs, compromising model behavior.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement model signature verification, sandbox model execution, and trigger detection in model outputs.

vulnerabilities.name: LangChain Agent Tool Injection
vulnerabilities.description: LangChain agents vulnerable to tool parameter injection, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary commands through compromised tool calls.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement tool parameter validation, sandbox tool execution, and audit all tool interactions.

vulnerabilities.name: Pinecone Vector Database Poisoning
vulnerabilities.description: Attackers can poison vector embeddings in Pinecone databases, causing RAG systems to retrieve malicious content instead of legitimate information.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement vector embedding verification, source authentication, and anomaly detection in retrieval results.

vulnerabilities.name: Replit AI Code Execution Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Replit's AI coding assistant can be tricked into generating and executing malicious code, bypassing sandbox restrictions.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement code execution sandboxing, static code analysis, and restrict generated code execution capabilities.

vulnerabilities.name: Stable Diffusion Prompt Injection
vulnerabilities.description: Stable Diffusion models vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can generate unintended or harmful images.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement prompt filtering, image content validation, and restrict generation of harmful content.

vulnerabilities.name: GitHub Copilot Training Data Leakage
vulnerabilities.description: Copilot can inadvertently leak snippets of training data, including proprietary code and sensitive information from private repositories.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement data filtering in training, differential privacy, and content validation in suggestions.

vulnerabilities.name: Weaviate Vector Search Manipulation
vulnerabilities.description: Weaviate vector databases can be manipulated to return poisoned search results, affecting RAG system outputs.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement vector integrity checks, source verification, and anomaly detection in search results.

vulnerabilities.name: OpenAI API Key Exfiltration via Prompt Injection
vulnerabilities.description: OpenAI API endpoints vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can exfiltrate API keys and other credentials from system configurations.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement credential isolation, API key rotation, and comprehensive input validation.

vulnerabilities.name: Meta Llama Model DoS via Recursive Generation
vulnerabilities.description: Llama models can be forced into infinite recursive generation loops, causing resource exhaustion and service disruption.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement generation limits, recursion detection, and resource monitoring.

vulnerabilities.name: Cohere API Rate Limit Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Cohere API rate limiting can be bypassed through prompt injection, allowing excessive API usage and potential DoS.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement robust rate limiting, request validation, and abuse detection.

vulnerabilities.name: Vertex AI Model Theft via API Probing
vulnerabilities.description: Google Vertex AI can be systematically probed to extract model parameters and capabilities for theft/replication.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement API monitoring, rate limiting, and model fingerprinting detection.

vulnerabilities.name: AWS Bedrock Jailbreak Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: AWS Bedrock models vulnerable to advanced jailbreak techniques, bypassing safety filters and generating harmful content.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement multi-layer safety filters, jailbreak detection, and content validation.

vulnerabilities.name: Databricks MLflow Model Poisoning
vulnerabilities.description: MLflow model registry can be poisoned with malicious models that activate backdoors when deployed.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement model validation, signature verification, and sandboxed testing before deployment.

vulnerabilities.name: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: NeMo Guardrails can be bypassed through sophisticated prompt engineering, allowing unsafe model behavior.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enhance guardrail robustness, implement multi-stage validation, and continuous testing.

vulnerabilities.name: Jupyter AI Extension Code Injection
vulnerabilities.description: Jupyter AI extension vulnerable to code injection attacks that can execute arbitrary code in the notebook environment.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement code sandboxing, input validation, and restrict code execution capabilities.

vulnerabilities.name: Hugging Face Transformers Library Backdoor
vulnerabilities.description: Malicious backdoor in Transformers library allows arbitrary code execution when loading compromised models.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement library integrity checks, model scanning, and sandboxed model loading.

vulnerabilities.name: OpenAI GPT-5 Multi-Turn Jailbreak
vulnerabilities.description: GPT-5 vulnerable to sophisticated multi-turn jailbreak attacks that gradually erode safety constraints.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement conversation-level safety monitoring, jailbreak detection across turns, and safety reset mechanisms.

vulnerabilities.name: Anthropic Claude Constitutional AI Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Claude's constitutional AI safety mechanisms can be bypassed through adversarial constitutional amendments.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement constitutional immutability, adversarial testing, and fallback safety mechanisms.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Gemini Multimodal Injection
vulnerabilities.description: Gemini multimodal models vulnerable to prompt injection through image and video inputs containing embedded instructions.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement multimodal input sanitization, content analysis, and cross-modal validation.

vulnerabilities.name: Meta Llama 4 Agent Autonomy Exploit
vulnerabilities.description: Llama 4 agent systems can be tricked into executing autonomous actions beyond their intended scope, including system modifications.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement strict agent boundaries, action approval workflows, and autonomy limits.

vulnerabilities.name: xAI Grok Hallucination Exploitation
vulnerabilities.description: Grok's helpful personality can be exploited to generate convincing but false information, leading to overreliance on incorrect data.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement fact-checking integration, confidence indicators, and source attribution requirements.

vulnerabilities.name: PyTorch Lightning Training Data Poisoning
vulnerabilities.description: PyTorch Lightning vulnerable to training data poisoning attacks that introduce backdoors into trained models.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement data validation, poisoning detection, and training pipeline security.

vulnerabilities.name: TensorFlow Serving Model Exfiltration
vulnerabilities.description: TensorFlow Serving can be exploited to exfiltrate model weights and architecture through systematic API queries.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement query monitoring, model obfuscation, and access controls.

vulnerabilities.name: LangChain Tools Shell Injection
vulnerabilities.description: LangChain tool execution vulnerable to shell injection attacks through crafted tool parameters.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement parameter sanitization, command whitelisting, and sandboxed execution.

vulnerabilities.name: FastAPI AI Endpoint SSRF
vulnerabilities.description: AI API endpoints built with FastAPI vulnerable to SSRF attacks through LLM-generated URLs.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement URL validation, SSRF protection, and output sanitization.

vulnerabilities.name: Ray AI Cluster Poisoning
vulnerabilities.description: Ray distributed AI clusters vulnerable to poisoning attacks that compromise model training across nodes.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement distributed validation, node isolation, and training integrity checks.

vulnerabilities.name: Gradio Interface XSS Injection
vulnerabilities.description: Gradio AI interfaces vulnerable to XSS attacks through malicious model outputs displayed in web interfaces.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement output sanitization, CSP headers, and XSS protection.

vulnerabilities.name: MLflow Model Registry Tampering
vulnerabilities.description: MLflow model registry can be tampered with to deploy poisoned models that appear legitimate.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement registry access controls, model verification, and deployment approval workflows.
